title: 何时支持Qwen3VL
body:
目前Qwen3VL的权重（235B和30B）都以开源，可以在https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen3-vl-68d2a7c1b8a8afce4ebd2dbe被找到。

另外，Qwen3VL关于MoE和稠密架构的代码也都开源了，请问作者大大有没有计划支持Qwen3VL呢

linked_prs.title: [model] add qwen3vl
linked_prs.body:
Fixes #517

Might need to set this environment variable: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/24696

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue is a feature request asking for support for the Qwen3VL model, which is an LLM. It relates to the "Unsupported models" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers," making it an agent issue.
